name: Bitmor
rootCause: Bitmor, a Bitcoin-focused DeFi protocol on Base, suffered an exploit on 25 May 2026. Attackers abused the DCA contract's access to active ERC-20 token approvals, draining about $6,000 from user wallets. No primary on-chain evidence or team disclosure is available; findings rely on consistent reports across several monitoring platforms. The DCA contract was able to use persistent ERC-20 token approvals without enforcing adequate limits on who could invoke token transfers or under what conditions, allowing attackers to withdraw funds from any user who had previously granted an approval.
